title: Ancho-Tilapia with Charred Corn Salsa
seoTitle: Ancho-Tilapia with Charred Corn Salsa | Firehall BBQ
shortDescription: Tilapia grill night—chili lime char, corn salsa, fast crew portions
subtitle: Cilantro-chili lime tilapia, charred corn salsa, and ten portions
description: Tilapia fillets marinate in chili-lime-cilantro paste, grill on oiled grates until 145°F, and serve with charred corn-black bean salsa.

steps.title: Build chili lime paste
steps.instruction: Blend lime juice, ancho powder, chipotle, half the cilantro, garlic, and salt into a paste.

steps.title: Marinate tilapia
steps.instruction: Coat fillets in paste. Marinate 20 minutes refrigerated only—acid toughens longer soaks.

steps.title: Char corn for salsa
steps.instruction: Grill corn at 425°F until charred. Cut kernels off cob. Toss with beans, onion, lime, and remaining cilantro.

steps.title: Heat grill
steps.instruction: Preheat grill to medium-high, 400°F. Oil grates generously.

steps.title: Grill tilapia
steps.instruction: Grill fillets 3–4 minutes per side until charred and 145°F internal. Use fish spatula—tilapia is fragile.

steps.title: Rest briefly
steps.instruction: Rest fillets 2 minutes. Transfer to hotel pans.

steps.title: Hold at 140°F
steps.instruction: Hold covered at 140°F up to 10 minutes max. Add avocado to salsa at service.

steps.title: Platter for ten
steps.instruction: Serve one fillet per firefighter with corn-black bean salsa and avocado.

proTips: 20-minute marinade max—lime turns tilapia mushy if over-soaked.
Oiled grates and fish spatula prevent fillet crumble.
Avocado in salsa at the line, not during hold.
tonightSpread: Chili lime grilled tilapia with charred corn salsa.
leftovers: Flake tilapia into fish tacos with extra salsa.
Chop into tortilla soup with lime.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Tilapia is budget-friendly and cooks in minutes. Chili-lime flavor is distinct from blackened cod or trout glaze—holds at 140°F briefly on platters.
mealPrepNotes: Marinate fillets 20 minutes max. Grill medium-high 400°F, 3–4 minutes per side. Hold covered at 140°F up to 10 minutes. Salsa at room temp.
